messages:
clara_cs: Morning team  Lantern weekly health check-in. Notable: p95/p99 divergence on two routes (compose_long, rerank). Streaming tails worse than sync on compose_long. Need quick mitigation and a long-term plan before renewal review.
devin_se: looking at the aggregates now. Compose_long p95 up 18% w/w, p99 up 42%. Model involved: redwood-open-8k and a customized prompt layer.
nate_sre: can you break down by mode? streaming vs non-streaming numbers?
devin_se: sure, quick sample:
- compose_long / redwood-open-8k / streaming: p95 420ms -> p95 drift 520ms, p99 1.1s -> 1.6s
- compose_long / redwood-open-8k / sync: p95 600ms, p99 750ms (tail much smaller)
- rerank / redwood-rerank-2 / streaming: p95 180ms, p99 290ms
- rerank / redwood-rerank-2 / sync: p95 150ms, p99 220ms
jordan_onboard: Lantern product said they recently enabled very short streaming chunks for snappy UX. Could be causing more kv cache churn / extra decode passes.
clara_cs: renewal risk: medium. Usage and spend fine, but product team flagged UX regressions. Need owners + timeline.
devin_se: quick mitigation idea: enable per-client prefix cache and increase streaming slot workers by 20% for compose_long. Also tune chunking threshold to 1200 tokens.
nate_sre: I want telemetry first  adding query to surface KV miss rate, worker queue time, and kernel latency by minute for last 90 mins. Will paste results in 30m.
opsbot: Note: approval needed for live config change. Use `/deploy canary lantern-compose-cache` to run canary.
jordan_onboard: I'll message Lantern PM to propose a tiny UX change (merge two small chunks into one when possible). They were open to an A/B test.
clara_cs: Action list:
- devin_se: implement conservative prefix_cache + worker bump as a canary. (due EOD)
- nate_sre: run telemetry query and share KV miss / queue metrics. (due +2h)
- jordan_onboard: confirm Lantern PM OKs chunking A/B and provide sample prompts. (due Tue)
- clara_cs: update renewal packet with mitigation steps and risk note. (due Tue)
devin_se: planned config patch (canary):
```
PATCH /configs/clients/lantern
{
  "routes": {
    "compose_long": {
      "streaming": {
        "prefix_cache": "on",
        "stream_workers": 8,
        "max_chunk_tokens": 1200
      }
    }
  }
}
```
devin_se: rolling canary now. Will watch p95/p99 and kv miss for 60m.
opsbot: Canary started -> lantern-compose-cache -> node-4
devin_se: first 15m: p99 for streaming compose_long moved from 1.6s -> 1.05s. p95 improved slightly. KV miss rate dropped ~22%.
clara_cs: solid. Nate, please confirm SLO impact once you have the full minute-by-minute.
nate_sre: posted telemetry snippet:
```
minute, kv_miss_pct, queue_ms_p95, kernel_ms_p95, p95_stream_ms, p99_stream_ms
09:12, 3.1, 18, 45, 510, 1050
09:11, 4.0, 25, 60, 610, 1600
09:10, 6.5, 40, 78, 720, 1800
```
nate_sre: conclusion: prefix cache cut kv miss pct and queue times. Kernel stayed stable. Suggest follow-up: optimize cache keying and explore quantized kernels for this model in next sprint.
jordan_onboard: Lantern PM replied: will try chunking tweak in A/B for 48h, provided prompt samples.
clara_cs: next steps for renewal packet: show delta table (pre/post canary) and proposed roadmap (cache keying + kernel quantization). If numbers hold for 24h, we'll mark latency risk mitigated.
devin_se: will update the telemetry board and add a plot to the renewal doc.
opsbot: Auto-note: this thread will be archived after 7 days of inactivity.
clara_cs: thanks team. I'll close loop after 24h stable window and add final numbers to renewal brief.
